title: Understanding the Design Matrix
text: The design matrix X is constructed using boolean featurization. Each column represents a food item, and each row represents whether that food was eaten (1) or not (0) for a particular lunch.

title: Interpreting the Matrix
text: In the design matrix, a row like (1, $$0$$, $$1$$, 0) indicates that the individual ate Rice and Orange Juice but not Pizza or Sushi.

title: Analyzing the Statement
text: Given the boolean featurization, does the sum of each feature vector represent the number of servings eaten of each food?
